request:
Goal: migrate repair-fingerprint manifests so existing active flows created with canonical format v2 can continue after the canonical hash input changed.

Scope: define a bumped current format and explicit v2 migration in repair-state identity and implementation repair-artifact handling; atomically and auditably rematerialize readable v2 artifacts; use the guarded recovery route to return affected flows to test-execute; add migration and integration-gate regression coverage.

Out of Scope: manual deletion or editing of mismatched artifacts; changing unrelated flow behavior or historical artifact formats beyond the required v2 migration.

Description: Existing v2 artifacts hash fields that are no longer part of the canonical state. When an active flow incorporates current main, integration gate must recognize and migrate the old artifact before stale-evidence processing, preserving an auditable path back to test-execute.
